title: 二叉树的最近公共祖先
statement:
给定二叉树的根节点 root 以及树中两个不同的节点 p 和 q，返回它们的最近公共祖先：同时以 p、q 为后代的节点中深度最大的那个（一个节点也视为自己的后代）。返回的必须是原树中的节点。

节点定义：struct TreeNode { int val; TreeNode *left; TreeNode *right; }。输入中的树为 LeetCode 层序表示，null 表示空位；树中节点值互不相同，p、q 在输入中以节点值给出，判题程序会找到对应节点再调用你的函数，并输出返回节点的值。

en.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
en.statement:
Given the root of a binary tree and two distinct nodes p and q in it, return their lowest common ancestor: the deepest node that has both p and q as descendants (a node counts as its own descendant). The returned node must be a node of the original tree.

Node definition: struct TreeNode { int val; TreeNode *left; TreeNode *right; }. The input tree uses LeetCode's level-order representation, with null marking empty positions; node values are all distinct, p and q are given in the input by their node values, and the judge finds the corresponding nodes before calling your function, then prints the value of the node you return.
constraints: The number of nodes is in [2, 10^5]; -10^9 ≤ Node.val ≤ 10^9; all node values are distinct
p ≠ q, and both p and q are in the tree

complexity.space: O(h) recursion stack, worst case O(n); the parent-pointer + ancestor-set approach is O(n).
complexity.notes: n is the number of nodes, h the tree height. The official limit is n = 10^5, but the level-order representation of 10^5 large-valued nodes would make the problem bank file exceed 1 MiB, so the local worst-case tests are reduced to 20001 nodes (a zigzag chain of 19999 nodes with two leaves p and q branching off its bottom, recursion depth about 2·10^4, which the default stack can handle) and a random tree of 10000 large-valued nodes.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is m (the number of level-order tokens); line 2 has m tokens (integers or null), the tree's LeetCode level-order representation; line 3 is the integer node value of p; line 4 is the integer node value of q. stdout: one integer, the node value of the lowest common ancestor.

constraints: 节点数在 [2, 10^5] 范围内；-10^9 ≤ Node.val ≤ 10^9；所有节点值互不相同
p ≠ q，且 p、q 均在树中

complexity.space: O(h) 递归栈，最坏 O(n)；父指针 + 祖先集合做法为 O(n)。
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: n 为节点数，h 为树高。官方上限 n = 10^5，但 10^5 个大值节点的层序表示会使题库文件超过 1 MiB，本地最坏测试缩小为 20001 个节点（19999 个节点的之字形单链，链底再分出 p、q 两个叶子，递归深度约 2·10^4，默认栈可承受）与 10000 个节点的大值随机树。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 m（层序 token 数）；第二行 m 个 token（整数或 null），为树的 LeetCode 层序表示；第三行整数 p 的节点值；第四行整数 q 的节点值。stdout：一个整数，最近公共祖先的节点值。
